This '''unknown individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] who attended a diplomatic function alongside Lord [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Thanaer ke Sekae]]. The event held on the [[Perator]] of [[Cartann]]'s [[Perator's palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Adumar<ref name="SOA" />

During the gathering, ke Sekae challenged [[Cartann Ground Champion]] [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]] to a [[blastsword]] duel after the latter had won two successive fights. Ke Sekae defeated the exhausted ke Hanadi with ease, striking her in the chest with his blastsword and incapacitating her. In accordance with Adumari custom, ke Sekae offered the choice of ke Hanadi's fate to his female companion, who held her palm down&mdash;the gesture signifying a [[Death/Legends|death sentence]].<ref name="SOA" />

She had blond hair and appealing looks, with innocent and carefree features.<ref name="SOA" />
